items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: It was Milton Baptiste. I started them all. ... I taught him too.

ctx.x: Besides your trumpet, besides your trumpet, uh, players, yeah, you must have a lot of general students. Do you remember who else was that in your, in any of your classes?

Uh, just about all of the, uh, musicians, all of the musicians who were my, around my age. Now like guys like Melvin Lasting and, uh, uh, Milton Batiste, they couldn't go there, they were too young. Right. They hadn't been into the service.
Right. I'm thinking people who were older.
Yeah. Okay. You know? And say, for instance, back in when I was 18, 19, 20, my idol was Wallace Davenport and Emory Thompson.
